plan.coverage_notes: The plan covers evidence-based treatments (CBT, IPT-A, BA, mindfulness, family-based, digital), psychopharmacology (SSRIs, combination therapy), assessment/safety (tools, suicide risk), contextual factors (social media, schools), and evidence standards (RCTs, meta-analyses, implementation). It deliberately excludes neuroimaging, biomarkers, and pure neuroscience based on the profile's anti-interests. It assumes the reader's primary interest is in clinically actionable research.
